content: Contentment is the supreme treasure; there is no wealth on earth that surpasses a peaceful mind.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
sourceWork: Santosha paramam sukham (सन्तोषः परमो लाभः) — Yoga Sutras & Hitopadesha
explanation: The disease of craving is like drinking saltwater: every gulp increases the burning thirst. The sage who has mastered Santosha (contentment) needs nothing from the emperor, and therefore can never be bought, bribed, or intimidated. Freedom is needing less.
practicalInsight: Choose a meal, outfit, or leisure activity of radical simplicity today. Savor the quiet luxury of needing nothing fancy.
reflectionPrompt: What desire are you chasing under the illusion that its fulfillment will bring the contentment that only contentment itself can provide?
